Determines how long each segment in a trail will last, in seconds.

The **Lifetime** property determines how long each segment in a trail will
last, in seconds, before it disappears. Defaults to 2 seconds but can be
set anywhere between 0.01 and 20.

The lifetime of a trail is also used by that effect's
`Class.Trail.Color|Color` and `Class.Trail.Transparency|Transparency`
properties to determine how each segment is drawn. Both of these
properties are sequences, meaning that they define their values at certain
keypoints in the segment's lifetime and then interpolate between the
values as the segment ages.

If a trail's lifetime changes, existing segments will immediately behave
as if they always had the new lifetime, meaning that if they've existed
for longer than the new lifetime, they will be removed immediately.
property/Trail/Lifetime.title: Lifetime

property/Trail/LightEmission.description:
Determines to what degree the colors of the trail are blended with the
colors behind it.

Determines to what degree the colors of the trail are blended with the
colors behind it. It should be set in the range of 0 to 1. A value of 0
uses normal blending modes and a value of 1 uses additive blending.

This property should not be confused with
`Class.Trail.LightInfluence|LightInfluence` which determines how the trail
is affected by environmental light.

Changing this property immediately affects all existing and future
segments of the trail.

This property does **not** cause the trail to light the environment.
property/Trail/LightEmission.title: LightEmission

property/Trail/LightInfluence.description:
Determines the degree to which the trail is influenced by the
environment's lighting.

Determines the degree to which the trail is influenced by the
environment's lighting, clamped between 0 and 1. When 0, the trail will be
unaffected by the environment's lighting. When 1, it will be fully
affected by lighting as a `Class.BasePart` would be.

Changing this property immediately affects all existing and future
segments of the trail.

See also `Class.Trail.LightEmission|LightEmission` which specifies to what
degree the colors of the trail are blended with the colors behind it.
property/Trail/LightInfluence.title: LightInfluence

property/Trail/LocalTransparencyModifier.description:
Determines a multiplier for `Class.Trail.Transparency` that is only
visible to the local client.

The `LocalTransparencyModifier` property is a multiplier applied to the
trail's `Class.Trail.Transparency|Transparency` that is only visible to
the local client. It does not replicate from client to server and is
useful for when a trail should not render for a specific client.

Uses the same formula as `Class.BasePart.LocalTransparencyModifier`:

`1` - ((`1` - `Class.Trail.Transparency|Transparency`) × (`1` -
`LocalTransparencyModifier`))

A value of `0` (default) has no effect on the trail's transparency. A
value of `1` makes the trail completely invisible to the local client
regardless of its `Class.Trail.Transparency|Transparency` value.
property/Trail/LocalTransparencyModifier.title: LocalTransparencyModifier

property/Trail/MaxLength.description:
Sets the maximum length of the trail.

This property determines the maximum length of the trail, in studs. Its
value defaults to 0, meaning that the trail will not have a maximum length
and trail segments will expire in their `Class.Trail.Lifetime|Lifetime`.

This property can be used alongside the `Class.Trail.MinLength|MinLength`
property which determines the minimum length a trail must be before it's
drawn.
property/Trail/MaxLength.title: MaxLength

property/Trail/MinLength.description:
Sets the minimum length of the trail.

This property determines the minimum length of the trail, in studs. If
neither of the trail's attachments have moved at least this value, no new
segments will be created and the endpoints of the current segment will be
moved to the current position of the attachments.

Note that changing this property will only affect **new** segments that
are drawn; any old segments that have already been drawn will maintain
their current length.

This property can be used alongside the `Class.Trail.MaxLength|MaxLength`
property which determines the maximum trail length before its oldest
segments are erased.
property/Trail/MinLength.title: MinLength

property/Trail/Texture.description:
The content ID of the texture to be displayed on the trail.

The content ID of the texture to be displayed on the trail. If this
property is not set, the trail will be displayed as a solid plane; this
also occurs when the texture is set to an invalid content ID or the image
associated with the texture has not yet loaded.

The appearance of the texture can be further modified by other trail
properties including `Class.Trail.Color|Color` and
`Class.Trail.Transparency|Transparency`.

Scaling of the texture is determined by the distance between
`Class.Trail.Attachment0|Attachment0` and
`Class.Trail.Attachment1|Attachment1`, as well as the
`Class.Trail.TextureMode|TextureMode`,
`Class.Trail.TextureLength|TextureLength`, and
`Class.Trail.WidthScale|WidthScale` properties.
property/Trail/Texture.title: Texture

property/Trail/TextureLength.description:
Sets the length of the trail's texture, dependent on
`Class.Trail.TextureMode|TextureMode`.

Sets the length of the trail's texture, dependent on
`Class.Trail.TextureMode|TextureMode`. Changing this property immediately
affects all existing and future trail segments.
property/Trail/TextureLength.title: TextureLength

property/Trail/TextureMode.description: Determines the manner in which the `Class.Trail.Texture|Texture` scales, repeats, and moves along with the trail's attachments. This property, alongside `Class.Trail.TextureLength|TextureLength`, determines how a trail's `Class.Trail.Texture|Texture` scales, repeats, and moves along with the trail's attachments. Changing this property immediately affects all existing and future trail segments. #### Scale and Repetition When **TextureMode** is set to `Enum.TextureMode.Wrap` or `Enum.TextureMode.Static`, the `Class.Trail.TextureLength|TextureLength` property sets the length of the texture as it repeats across the trail's length. When **TextureMode** is set to `Enum.TextureMode.Stretch`, the texture will repeat `Class.Trail.TextureLength|TextureLength` times across the trail's overall length. #### Movement The **TextureMode** property also affects the **movement** of the trail's texture as follows: - If set to `Enum.TextureMode.Stretch`, the texture will stretch out based on the lifetime of the trail, and shrink inwards if the trail's attachments stop moving. - If set to `Enum.TextureMode.Wrap`, the texture will be tiled as the length of the trail changes, but the textures will remain stationary relative to their attachments. - If set to `Enum.TextureMode.Static`, the texture will be rolled out as the attachments move, and they will remain in place until their lifetime is met. This setting is ideal for trail textures that should appear "stamped" where rendered, such as paw prints or tire tracks.
property/Trail/TextureMode.title: TextureMode

property/Trail/Transparency.description:
Sets the transparency of the trail's segments over its
`Class.Trail.Lifetime|Lifetime`.

Sets the transparency of the trail's segments over its
`Class.Trail.Lifetime|Lifetime`. This value is a
`Datatype.NumberSequence`, meaning it can be a static value or can change
throughout the lifetime of the trail segments.
property/Trail/Transparency.title: Transparency

property/Trail/WidthScale.description:
Scales the width of the trail over the course of its lifetime.

This property is a `Datatype.NumberSequence` that scales the width of the
trail over the course of its lifetime. Values can range between 0 and 1,
acting as a multiplier on the distance between the trail's attachments.
For example, if the trail's attachments are 2 stud's apart and the value
of this property is 0.5, the trail's width will be 1 stud and the trail
will be centered between the two attachments.
property/Trail/WidthScale.title: WidthScale

property/Translator/LocaleId.description:
The locale of translated strings.

The Roblox locale of the output translated strings from this table, for
example "en-us" or "es-es." Defaults to "en-us".
property/Translator/LocaleId.title: LocaleId

property/TremoloSoundEffect/Depth.description:
Controls how much the volume will raise and lower.

Range: 0 to 1 (default 1) Controls how much the volume will raise and
lower. This value ranges between 0 (minimum volume) and 1 (maximum
volume). If set to its minimum, the volume will not oscillate at all.
property/TremoloSoundEffect/Depth.title: Depth

property/TremoloSoundEffect/Duty.description:
Controls how long during one volume oscillation the effect will be active.

Range: 0 to 1 (default 0.5) Controls how long during one volume
oscillation the effect will be active, specifically what percentage
between 0 (0%) and 1 (100%).
property/TremoloSoundEffect/Duty.title: Duty

property/TremoloSoundEffect/Frequency.description:
Sets how often the effect will oscillate the volume.

Range: 0.1 to 20 (default 5) Sets how often the effect will oscillate the
volume. Measured in Hz.
property/TremoloSoundEffect/Frequency.title: Frequency

property/TriangleMeshPart/CollisionFidel.description:
Determines the level of detail the part's physics will adhere to its mesh.

This property determines how the collision model of the
`Class.TriangleMeshPart` relates to the actual geometry of the mesh. This
property cannot be read or manipulated by scripts during runtime.

See [here](../../../workspace/collisions.md#collision-fidelity) for a
visual representation of the various options.
property/TriangleMeshPart/CollisionFidel.title: CollisionFidelity

property/TriangleMeshPart/FluidFidelity.description:
Determines the geometric representation used to compute aerodynamic forces
and torques.

Controls which geometric representation the physics engine uses when it
computes aerodynamic (fluid) forces and torques for the part. It defaults
to `Enum.FluidFidelity.Automatic`, in which the engine selects a
representation on your behalf.

- `Enum.FluidFidelity.Automatic` — the engine chooses the representation;
  it currently evaluates fluid forces against the part's collision
  geometry.
- `Enum.FluidFidelity.UseCollisionGeometry` — fluid forces are evaluated
  against the part's collision geometry, matching the shape used for
  collision detection.
- `Enum.FluidFidelity.UsePreciseGeometry` — fluid forces are evaluated
  against the part's precise mesh geometry, producing more accurate forces
  at a higher computational cost.

Because this property has plugin-level write security, it is configured in
Studio rather than assigned by runtime scripts.

This setting only affects a part while fluid forces are active for the
place, which is governed by `Class.Workspace.FluidForces` (an
`Enum.FluidForces` value that defaults to `Default`; setting it to
`Experimental` enables the aerodynamic force model). When fluid forces are
not applied to the part, the chosen fidelity has no effect.
property/TriangleMeshPart/FluidFidelity.title: FluidFidelity

property/TriangleMeshPart/MeshSize.description:
The original size of the part's source mesh geometry, before any scaling
applied through `Class.BasePart.Size`.

This read-only property reports the size of the part's mesh geometry when
it was loaded, as width, height, and depth in studs. It is not affected by
resizing the part through `Class.BasePart.Size`, so dividing
`Class.BasePart.Size` by `MeshSize` gives the scale factor currently
applied to the mesh's visual and physical geometry.
property/TriangleMeshPart/MeshSize.title: MeshSize

property/TrussPart/Style.description:
Sets what the truss looks like.

Sets what the truss looks like, from the following options:

- `Enum.Style.AlternatingSupports`
- `Enum.Style.BridgeStyleSupports`
- `Enum.Style.NoSupports`
property/TrussPart/Style.title: Style

property/Tween/Instance.description:
Read-only property that points to the `Class.Instance` whose properties
are being interpolated by the tween.

This property of a `Class.Tween` (read-only) points to the
`Class.Instance` whose properties are being interpolated.
property/Tween/Instance.title: Instance

property/TweenBase/PlaybackState.description:
Read-only property that shows the current state for the `Class.Tween`
animation.

Read-only property that shows the current stage for the `Class.Tween`
animation. See `Enum.PlaybackState` for descriptions of each state. Change
using functions like `Class.Tween:Play()`.
property/TweenBase/PlaybackState.title: PlaybackState

property/UIAspectRatioConstraint/AspectR.description:
Determines the width-to-height ratio to maintain.

This property determines the width‑to‑height ratio to maintain. To flip
the ratio to height‑to‑width, take the inverse (divide `1` by the number
or raise to the -1st power). This value must be greater than `0`.
property/UIAspectRatioConstraint/AspectR.title: AspectRatio

property/UIAspectRatioConstraint/AspectT.description:
Determines how the maximum size of the object is limited.

This property determines how the maximum size of the object is limited.

- When set to `Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize|FitWithinMaxSize`, the
  object will be the maximum size possible within its own
  `Class.GuiBase2d.AbsoluteSize|AbsoluteSize`.

- When set to `Enum.AspectType.ScaleWithParentSize|ScaleWithParentSize`,
  the object's maximum size will be the size of the parent while still
  maintaining the aspect ratio.
property/UIAspectRatioConstraint/AspectT.title: AspectType

property/UIAspectRatioConstraint/Dominan.description:
Determines the axis to use when setting the new size of the object.

This property determines which axis to use when setting the new size of
the object, assuming it would otherwise exceed the size of the parent.
property/UIAspectRatioConstraint/Dominan.title: DominantAxis

property/UICorner/BottomLeftRadius.description:
Determines the radius of the bottom-left corner.

This property is currently in beta. To use it, enable **New UI
Capabilities** in Studio's beta features window.

A `Datatype.UDim` property that determines the radius of the bottom-left
corner independently. Setting `Class.UICorner.CornerRadius|CornerRadius`
overwrites all four individual corner radii to the same value.
property/UICorner/BottomLeftRadius.title: BottomLeftRadius

property/UICorner/BottomRightRadius.description:
Determines the radius of the bottom-right corner.

This property is currently in beta. To use it, enable **New UI
Capabilities** in Studio's beta features window.

A `Datatype.UDim` property that determines the radius of the bottom-right
corner independently. Setting `Class.UICorner.CornerRadius|CornerRadius`
overwrites all four individual corner radii to the same value.
property/UICorner/BottomRightRadius.title: BottomRightRadius

property/UICorner/CornerRadius.description:
Sets all four corner radii at once and reads from
`Class.UICorner.TopLeftRadius|TopLeftRadius`.

A convenience `Datatype.UDim` property that acts as a shorthand for the
four individual corner radius properties. Writing to this property sets
`Class.UICorner.TopLeftRadius|TopLeftRadius`,
`Class.UICorner.TopRightRadius|TopRightRadius`,
`Class.UICorner.BottomRightRadius|BottomRightRadius`, and
`Class.UICorner.BottomLeftRadius|BottomLeftRadius` to the same value.
Reading this property returns the value of
`Class.UICorner.TopLeftRadius|TopLeftRadius`.
property/UICorner/CornerRadius.title: CornerRadius

property/UICorner/TopLeftRadius.description:
Determines the radius of the top-left corner.

This property is currently in beta. To use it, enable **New UI
Capabilities** in Studio's beta features window.

A `Datatype.UDim` property that determines the radius of the top-left
corner independently. Setting `Class.UICorner.CornerRadius|CornerRadius`
overwrites all four individual corner radii to the same value.
property/UICorner/TopLeftRadius.title: TopLeftRadius

property/UICorner/TopRightRadius.description:
Determines the radius of the top-right corner.

This property is currently in beta. To use it, enable **New UI
Capabilities** in Studio's beta features window.

A `Datatype.UDim` property that determines the radius of the top-right
corner independently. Setting `Class.UICorner.CornerRadius|CornerRadius`
overwrites all four individual corner radii to the same value.
property/UICorner/TopRightRadius.title: TopRightRadius

property/UIDragDetector/ActivatedCursorI.description:
Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is activated over the
parent of this `Class.UIDragDetector`.

Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is activated over the
parent of this `Class.UIDragDetector`. If this property is left blank, the
detector will use the default icon.

To change the activated cursor icon, set this property to the asset ID of
the image you'd like to use.
property/UIDragDetector/ActivatedCursorI.title: ActivatedCursorIcon

property/UIDragDetector/ActivatedCursorI.description:
Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is activated over the
parent of this `Class.UIDragDetector`. Only supports asset URIs

Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is activated over the
parent of this `Class.UIDragDetector`. If this property is left blank, the
detector will use the default icon.

To change the activated cursor icon, set this property to the asset ID of
the image you'd like to use. Only asset URIs are supported for this
property.
property/UIDragDetector/ActivatedCursorI.title: ActivatedCursorIconContent

property/UIDragDetector/BoundingBehavior.description:
Determines bounding behavior of the dragged UI object when the detector's
`Class.UIDragDetector.BoundingUI|BoundingUI` is set.

Determines bounding behavior of the dragged UI object when the detector's
`Class.UIDragDetector.BoundingUI|BoundingUI` is set. See
`Enum.UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior` for details on each setting's
behavior.
property/UIDragDetector/BoundingBehavior.title: BoundingBehavior

property/UIDragDetector/BoundingUI.description:
Instance whose bounding area defines the drag boundaries for the parent
`Class.GuiObject`.

When set, the `Class.UIDragDetector` instance will not allow the bounds of
the parent `Class.GuiObject` to be dragged outside the bounds of the
**BoundingUI** instance.

Note that if a portion of the parent `Class.GuiObject` is outside the
**BoundingUI** bounds, the initial input position at drag start and its
relative position during drag will be used for bounding detection until
the entirety of the dragged object is within the bounds, after which the
object will be constrained inside the bounds.
property/UIDragDetector/BoundingUI.title: BoundingUI

property/UIDragDetector/CursorIcon.description:
Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is hovered over the parent
of this `Class.UIDragDetector`.

Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is hovered over the parent
of this `Class.UIDragDetector`. If this property is left blank, the
detector will use the default icon.

To change the cursor icon, set this property to the asset ID of the image
you'd like to use.
property/UIDragDetector/CursorIcon.title: CursorIcon

property/UIDragDetector/CursorIconConten.description:
Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is hovered over the parent
of this `Class.UIDragDetector`. Only asset URIs are supported.

Sets the cursor icon to display when the mouse is hovered over the parent
of this `Class.UIDragDetector`. If this property is left blank, the
detector will use the default icon.

To change the cursor icon, set this property to the asset ID of the image
you'd like to use. Only asset URIs are supported for this property.
property/UIDragDetector/CursorIconConten.title: CursorIconContent

property/UIDragDetector/DragAxis.description:
The drag axis for the `Class.UIDragDetector` instance when
`Class.UIDragDetector.DragStyle|DragStyle` is set to
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslateLine`.

`Datatype.Vector2` value that defines the axis of movement for the dragged
object when `Class.UIDragDetector.DragStyle|DragStyle` is set to
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslateLine`. The axis is defined in the
local space of the `Class.UIDragDetector` unless
`Class.UIDragDetector.ReferenceUIInstance|ReferenceUIInstance` is defined,
in which case the axis is defined in that instance's local space.
property/UIDragDetector/DragAxis.title: DragAxis

property/UIDragDetector/DragRelativity.description:
Sets the paradigm which defines the relativity of inputs/outputs from a
custom drag function.

Only applies if a custom drag function is registered through
`Class.UIDragDetector:SetDragStyleFunction()|SetDragStyleFunction()` or
`Class.UIDragDetector:AddConstraintFunction()|AddConstraintFunction()`.
Sets the paradigm which defines the relativity of the registered
function's inputs/outputs.

For example, returning a `Datatype.UDim2.fromOffset(1, 0)` from a
registered function with this property set to
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragRelativity.Absolute` will move the detector's
parent **to** `(1, 0)` in the designated
`Class.UIDragDetector.DragSpace|DragSpace`, while returning the same
`Datatype.UDim2` with this property set to
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragRelativity.Relative` will move the detector's
parent **by** `(1, 0)` in the designated
`Class.UIDragDetector.DragSpace|DragSpace`.
property/UIDragDetector/DragRelativity.title: DragRelativity

property/UIDragDetector/DragRotation.description:
The rotation performed by the current drag.

The rotation performed by the current drag. This value is defined in
degrees relative to the local space of the `Class.UIDragDetector` unless
`Class.UIDragDetector.ReferenceUIInstance|ReferenceUIInstance` is defined,
in which case the rotation is defined in the local space of that instance
and from its positive **X** axis.

This property can be changed while there is no active drag to rotate the
dragged object.
property/UIDragDetector/DragRotation.title: DragRotation

property/UIDragDetector/DragSpace.description:
Sets the paradigm which defines the space of inputs/outputs from a custom
drag function.

Only applies if a custom drag function is registered through
`Class.UIDragDetector:SetDragStyleFunction()|SetDragStyleFunction()` or
`Class.UIDragDetector:AddConstraintFunction()|AddConstraintFunction()`.
Sets the paradigm which defines the space of the registered function's
inputs/outputs.

For example, if the detector's parent `Class.GuiObject` is a child of a
parent `Class.GuiObject` that's rotated:

- Returning a `Datatype.UDim2.fromOffset(1, 0)` from a registered function
  with this property set to `Enum.UIDragDetectorDragSpace.Parent` will
  move the detector's parent `Class.GuiObject` to the right by 1 pixel in
  the local space affected by its parent's rotation.

- Returning a `Datatype.UDim2.fromOffset(1, 0)` from a registered function
  with this property set to `Enum.UIDragDetectorDragSpace.LayerCollector`
  will move the detector's parent `Class.GuiObject` to the right by 1
  pixel in the space of the `Class.LayerCollector`.
property/UIDragDetector/DragSpace.title: DragSpace

property/UIDragDetector/DragStyle.description:
The paradigm used to generate proposed motion.

The paradigm used to generate proposed motion, given a stream of input
position vectors. See `Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle` for options.
property/UIDragDetector/DragStyle.title: DragStyle

property/UIDragDetector/DragUDim2.description:
The translation performed by the current drag expressed in a
`Datatype.UDim2` value.

The translation performed by the current drag expressed in a
`Datatype.UDim2` value. Translation is done through
`Datatype.UDim.Offset|Offset` or `Datatype.UDim.Scale|Scale` value changes
depending on the `Class.UIDragDetector.DragRelativity|DragRelativity`
value, and it is relative to the detector's local space unless a
`Class.UIDragDetector.ReferenceUIInstance|ReferenceUIInstance` is defined.

This property can be changed while there is no active drag to move the
dragged object.
property/UIDragDetector/DragUDim2.title: DragUDim2

property/UIDragDetector/Enabled.description:
Whether the `Class.UIDragDetector` responds to user input.

If `true`, the `Class.UIDragDetector` responds to user input; if `false`,
it does not.
property/UIDragDetector/Enabled.title: Enabled

property/UIDragDetector/MaxDragAngle.description:
Along with `Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragAngle|MinDragAngle`, impedes the
detector's attempts to generate rotational motion.

If this property is greater than
`Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragAngle|MinDragAngle`, rotation will be clamped
within the range of `Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragAngle|MinDragAngle` and
`Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragAngle|MaxDragAngle`. Positive values impede
clockwise rotation while negative values impede counterclockwise rotation.

This is not a constraint; it merely impedes the detector's attempts to
generate motion in order to remain within limits. See
`Class.UIDragDetector:AddConstraintFunction()|AddConstraintFunction()` to
add custom constraint to a drag.

Only relevant if `Class.UIDragDetector.DragStyle|DragStyle` is
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.Rotate`.
property/UIDragDetector/MaxDragAngle.title: MaxDragAngle

property/UIDragDetector/MaxDragTranslati.description:
Along with `Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragTranslation|MinDragTranslation`,
impedes the detector's attempts to generate linear/planar motion.

If the corresponding `Datatype.UDim.Offset|Offset` and/or
`Datatype.UDim.Scale|Scale` values are greater than those of
`Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragTranslation|MinDragTranslation` in all
dimensions, linear/planar translation will be clamped within the range of
`Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragTranslation|MinDragTranslation` and
`Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragTranslation|MaxDragTranslation`.

This is not a constraint; it merely impedes the detector's attempts to
generate motion in order to remain within limits. See
`Class.UIDragDetector:AddConstraintFunction()|AddConstraintFunction()` to
add custom constraint to a drag.

Only relevant if `Class.UIDragDetector.DragStyle|DragStyle` is
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslateLine` or
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslatePlane`.
property/UIDragDetector/MaxDragTranslati.title: MaxDragTranslation

property/UIDragDetector/MinDragAngle.description:
Along with `Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragAngle|MaxDragAngle`, impedes the
detector's attempts to generate rotational motion.

If this property is less than
`Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragAngle|MaxDragAngle`, rotation will be clamped
within the range of `Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragAngle|MinDragAngle` and
`Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragAngle|MaxDragAngle`. Positive values impede
clockwise rotation while negative values impede counterclockwise rotation.

This is not a constraint; it merely impedes the detector's attempts to
generate motion in order to remain within limits. See
`Class.UIDragDetector:AddConstraintFunction()|AddConstraintFunction()` to
add custom constraint to a drag.

Only relevant if `Class.UIDragDetector.DragStyle|DragStyle` is
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.Rotate`.
property/UIDragDetector/MinDragAngle.title: MinDragAngle

property/UIDragDetector/MinDragTranslati.description:
Along with `Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragTranslation|MaxDragTranslation`,
impedes the detector's attempts to generate linear/planar motion.

If the corresponding `Datatype.UDim.Offset|Offset` and/or
`Datatype.UDim.Scale|Scale` values are less than those of
`Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragTranslation|MaxDragTranslation` in all
dimensions, linear/planar translation will be clamped within the range of
`Class.UIDragDetector.MinDragTranslation|MinDragTranslation` and
`Class.UIDragDetector.MaxDragTranslation|MaxDragTranslation`.

This is not a constraint; it merely impedes the detector's attempts to
generate motion in order to remain within limits. See
`Class.UIDragDetector:AddConstraintFunction()|AddConstraintFunction()` to
add custom constraint to a drag.

Only relevant if `Class.UIDragDetector.DragStyle|DragStyle` is
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslateLine` or
`Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslatePlane`.
property/UIDragDetector/MinDragTranslati.title: MinDragTranslation

property/UIDragDetector/ReferenceUIInsta.description:
A `Class.GuiObject` instance whose local space and absolute center
position is the reference space and origin for the detector.

A `Class.GuiObject` instance whose local space and absolute center
position is the reference space and origin for the detector. Setting this
reference affects properties such as
`Class.UIDragDetector.DragUDim2|DragUDim2`,
`Class.UIDragDetector.DragRotation|DragRotation`, and the behavior of
`Class.UIDragDetector.DragAxis|DragAxis`.
property/UIDragDetector/ReferenceUIInsta.title: ReferenceUIInstance

property/UIDragDetector/ResponseStyle.description:
The paradigm used to define the response to proposed motion.

Once the proposed motion has been computed and potentially constrained,
this paradigm is used to deterimine how to move (or not move) the
`Class.GuiObject` affected by the `Class.UIDragDetector`. See
`Enum.UIDragDetectorResponseStyle` for options.
property/UIDragDetector/ResponseStyle.title: ResponseStyle

property/UIDragDetector/SelectionModeDra.description:
Maximum drag speed for translation.

Defines the maximum drag speed for translation as a combination of
`Datatype.UDim.Scale|Scale` and `Datatype.UDim.Offset|Offset` of the first
ancestor `Class.ScreenGui` or `Class.SurfaceGui` the
`Class.UIDragDetector` belongs to. This value must be positive and any
value below `0` will be clamped to `0`.
property/UIDragDetector/SelectionModeDra.title: SelectionModeDragSpeed

property/UIDragDetector/SelectionModeRot.description:
Maximum angle per second the `Class.UIDragDetector` can rotate at.

Defines the maximum angle per second at which the `Class.UIDragDetector`
can rotate. This value must be positive and any value below `0` will be
clamped to `0`.
property/UIDragDetector/SelectionModeRot.title: SelectionModeRotateSpeed

property/UIDragDetector/UIDragSpeedAxisM.description:
`Enum.UIDragSpeedAxisMapping` value that determines the **X**/**Y**
dimension dragging speeds.
property/UIDragDetector/UIDragSpeedAxisM.title: UIDragSpeedAxisMapping

property/UIFlexItem/FlexMode.description: How the parent `Class.GuiObject` grows or shrinks with available space in the flex layout container. `Enum.UIFlexMode` value which defines how the parent `Class.GuiObject` grows or shrinks with available space in the [flex layout](../../../ui/list-flex-layouts.md#flex-layouts) container. When the container's size is **larger** than the flex line's combined basis size, a value of `Enum.UIFlexMode.Grow` sets an effective `1:0` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent `Class.GuiObject`. Objects set to `Enum.UIFlexMode.Grow` never shrink below their basis size, so overflow may occur if the container becomes smaller than the line's combined basis size. When the container's size is **smaller** than the flex line's combined basis size and the controlling `Class.UIListLayout` is **not** set to wrap (resulting in overflow), a value of `Enum.UIFlexMode.Shrink` sets an effective `0:1` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent `Class.GuiObject`. Objects set to `Enum.UIFlexMode.Shrink` never grow above their basis size, so underflow may occur if the container becomes larger than the line's combined basis size. When the container's size is either larger or smaller than the flex line's combined basis size, a value of `Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill` sets an effective `1:1` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent `Class.GuiObject`. This setting ensures the flex line always fills the container, even if the container size changes. For fine-tuned layouts, a value of `Enum.UIFlexMode.Custom` enables the `Class.UIFlexItem.GrowRatio|GrowRatio` and `Class.UIFlexItem.ShrinkRatio|ShrinkRatio` properties, allowing for relative growth or shrinking of the object in a ratio compared to other flex objects also under control of a `Class.UIFlexItem`.
property/UIFlexItem/FlexMode.title: FlexMode

property/UIFlexItem/GrowRatio.description:
Determines the amount the parent `Class.GuiObject` grows relative to other
items in the line. Applies only if `Class.UIFlexItem.FlexMode|FlexMode` is
set to `Enum.UIFlexMode.Custom`.

If there is free space in the flex line, this property determines the
amount the parent `Class.GuiObject` grows relative to other flex items in
the line. Applies only if `Class.UIFlexItem.FlexMode|FlexMode` is set to
`Enum.UIFlexMode.Custom`.
property/UIFlexItem/GrowRatio.title: GrowRatio

property/UIFlexItem/ItemLineAlignment.description:
Cross-axis alignment of the specific parent `Class.GuiObject` within the
flex line.

Cross-axis alignment of the specific parent `Class.GuiObject` within the
flex line. See `Class.UIListLayout.ItemLineAlignment` for details.
property/UIFlexItem/ItemLineAlignment.title: ItemLineAlignment

property/UIFlexItem/ShrinkRatio.description:
Determines the amount the parent `Class.GuiObject` shrinks relative to
other items in the line. Applies only if
`Class.UIFlexItem.FlexMode|FlexMode` is set to `Enum.UIFlexMode.Custom`.

If there is overflow in the flex line, this property determines the amount
the parent `Class.GuiObject` shrinks relative to other flex items in the
line. Applies only if `Class.UIFlexItem.FlexMode|FlexMode` is set to
`Enum.UIFlexMode.Custom`.
property/UIFlexItem/ShrinkRatio.title: ShrinkRatio

property/UIGradient/Color.description:
Determines the color blended with the parent GuiObject along the length of
the gradient.

This property describes the color to blend with the parent UI element
along the provided `Datatype.ColorSequence`. This property works in a
similar manner to `Class.Beam.Color` or `Class.Trail.Color`, except that
it applies over an on-screen distance determined by the
`Class.UIGradient.Offset|Offset` and `Class.UIGradient.Rotation|Rotation`.
property/UIGradient/Color.title: Color

property/UIGradient/Enabled.description: Whether the gradient is enabled or not.
property/UIGradient/Enabled.title: Enabled

property/UIGradient/Offset.description:
Determines the scalar translation of the gradient from the center of the
parent GuiObject.

This property determines the scalar translation of the gradient from the
center of the parent `Class.GuiObject`. It is a scalar translation,
meaning that the actual logical pixel offset is determined by the
`Class.GuiBase2d.AbsoluteSize|AbsoluteSize` of the parent
`Class.GuiObject`. So, a value of `(1, 0)` would shift the gradient
horizontally to the right by a distance equal to the parent object's
on‑screen size. Depending on the `Class.UIGradient.Rotation|Rotation`,
this may cause the gradient to be partially visible or not visible at all.

Also see `Class.UIGradient.Rotation|Rotation` which also affects the
geometry of the applied gradient.
property/UIGradient/Offset.title: Offset

property/UIGradient/Rotation.description:
Determines the clockwise rotation in degrees of the gradient starting from
left to right.

This property determines the **clockwise** rotation in degrees of the
`Class.UIGradient` starting from left to right. The beginning and end
control points snap to the edges of the parent `Class.GuiObject`, but
maintain the provided rotation.

Also see `Class.UIGradient.Offset|Offset` which also affects the geometry
of the applied gradient.
property/UIGradient/Rotation.title: Rotation

property/UIGradient/Transparency.description:
Determines how much the parent GuiObject can be seen through along the
length of the gradient.

This property describes how opaque the parent UI element will be along the
provided `Datatype.NumberSequence`. This property works in a similar
manner to `Class.Beam.Transparency` or `Class.Trail.Transparency`, except
that it applies over an on‑screen distance determined by the
`Class.UIGradient.Offset|Offset` and `Class.UIGradient.Rotation|Rotation`.

Note that the envelope values of the
`Datatype.NumberSequenceKeypoint|NumberSequenceKeypoints` are ignored.
property/UIGradient/Transparency.title: Transparency

property/UIGridLayout/AbsoluteCellCount.description:
The number of elements in the grid.

Measures the maximum number of elements in each direction. Read-only.
property/UIGridLayout/AbsoluteCellCount.title: AbsoluteCellCount

property/UIGridLayout/AbsoluteCellSize.description:
The absolute size of each element in the grid.

Provides the size of each element of the grid in offsets. Read-only. Not
affected by any `Class.UIScale`, `Class.UISizeConstraint` or
`Class.UIAspectRatioConstraint` applied to any individual element in the
grid.
property/UIGridLayout/AbsoluteCellSize.title: AbsoluteCellSize

property/UIGridLayout/CellPadding.description:
Determines how much space there is between elements in the grid.

(default {0, 5},{0, 5}) Determines how much space there is between
elements in the grid. As with all UDim2s, this space can be both in a
percentage of the parent container's size and raw pixel offset.
property/UIGridLayout/CellPadding.title: CellPadding

property/UIGridLayout/CellSize.description:
Determines the size of each element in the grid.

(default {0, 100},{0, 100}) Determines the size of each element in the
grid. As with all UDim2s, this size can be both in a percentage of the
parent container's size and raw pixel offset. If the element being size
has a `Class.UIConstraint` then the size will be determined by the
constraint, not the grid.
property/UIGridLayout/CellSize.title: CellSize

property/UIGridLayout/FillDirectionMaxCe.description:
Determines the maximum number of cells that may be used in a row or column
before the next one is started.

FillDirectionMaxCells determines the number of cells in the grid that can
be used before continuing on the next row/column (whether this is a row or
column is dependent on `Class.UIGridStyleLayout.FillDirection`). This
value must be non-negative.

- If set to zero, there is no maximum number of cells that may appear in
  one row/column except for how many can fit within the parent UI element.
- If set to one, this creates a list similar to those created by
  `Class.UIListLayout`.
property/UIGridLayout/FillDirectionMaxCe.title: FillDirectionMaxCells

property/UIGridLayout/StartCorner.description:
Determines from which corner the grid starts laying out UI elements.

StartCorner (`Enum.StartCorner`) determines from which corner the grid
starts laying out UI elements. The grid continues in the
`Class.UIGridStyleLayout.FillDirection`, filling elements one by one until
`Class.UIGridLayout.FIllDirectionMaxCells` cells have been laid out in
that row/column or if all the parent UI element's space has been occupied
by previous cells.

Above, the potion is the first `Class.ImageLabel`, followed by the gem and
the sword. The UIGridLayout is using a `Enum.StartCorner` of BottomRight.
The `Class.UIGridStyleLayout.FillDirection` is Horizontal.
property/UIGridLayout/StartCorner.title: StartCorner

property/UIGridStyleLayout/AbsoluteConte.description:
The absolute size of space being taken up by the grid layout.

The **AbsoluteContentSize** property of a `Class.UIGridStyleLayout`
reveals how much space the elements of the grid are taking up, including
any padding created by the grid. This property is particularly useful to
size containers of grids such as `Class.Frame|Frames` to make sure they
aren't any larger than the grid itself.

This property updates as soon as it's read. It will not fire a
`Class.Object.Changed` event immediately after the UI has changed, but if
the value is read, it will become current and a `Class.Object.Changed`
event will fire on the next render step.
property/UIGridStyleLayout/AbsoluteConte.title: AbsoluteContentSize

property/UIGridStyleLayout/FillDirection.description: Determines the axis in which UI objects are laid out. The **FillDirection** property determines the axis in which UI elements are laid out. `Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal` arranges objects from left to right, while `Enum.FillDirection.Vertical` arranges objects from top to bottom. To reverse elements, such as to arrange right to left, you'll need to reverse the sorting; for example by negating the child UI objects' `Class.GuiObject.LayoutOrder` values when `Class.UIGridStyleLayout.SortOrder` is set to `Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder`.
property/UIGridStyleLayout/FillDirection.title: FillDirection

property/UIGridStyleLayout/HorizontalAli.description:
Determines the horizontal alignment of UI elements within the parent
element.

The **HorizontalAlignment** property determines the **X** axis alignment
of the grid of UI elements, much like `Class.TextLabel.TextXAlignment`
does with `Class.TextLabel.Text`.
property/UIGridStyleLayout/HorizontalAli.title: HorizontalAlignment

property/UIGridStyleLayout/SortOrder.description: Determines the order in which child UI objects are placed in a layout. The **SortOrder** property determines the order in which child UI objects are placed in a layout. For `Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder`, an ascending sort is used on the `Class.GuiObject.LayoutOrder|LayoutOrder` property of child UI objects. If two children share the same `Class.GuiObject.LayoutOrder|LayoutOrder`, whichever was added sooner to the parent object takes precedence. For `Enum.SortOrder.Name`, an alphanumeric sort is used on the `Class.Instance.Name` of the child UI objects.
property/UIGridStyleLayout/SortOrder.title: SortOrder

property/UIGridStyleLayout/VerticalAlign.description:
Determines the vertical alignment of UI elements within the parent
element.

The **VerticalAlignment** property determines the **Y** axis alignment of
the grid of UI elements, much like `Class.TextLabel.TextYAlignment` does
with `Class.TextLabel.Text`.
property/UIGridStyleLayout/VerticalAlign.title: VerticalAlignment

property/UIListLayout/HorizontalFlex.description:
Controls how to distribute extra horizontal space. When the list layout's `Class.UIListLayout.FillDirection|FillDirection` is set to `Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal`, the `Class.UIListLayout.HorizontalFlex|HorizontalFlex` property specifies how to distribute extra horizontal space in the parent container.
Setting Sibling Behavior
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None|None No flex behavior; siblings maintain their defined width.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill|Fill Siblings resize horizontally to fill the entire parent container, overriding their defined width. The number of siblings in a row remain unchanged; for example, if three siblings fit horizontally within the container's width under the Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None|None setting, those three siblings will resize to fill the entire width.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceAround|SpaceAround Siblings maintain their defined width. Equal spacing is added on both sides of each sibling.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceBetween|SpaceBetween Siblings maintain their defined width. Equal spacing is added between siblings, but no additional space is added around siblings.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceEvenly|SpaceEvenly Siblings maintain their defined width. Equal spacing is added both between and around siblings.
##### Cross-Direction Behavior In **vertical** list layouts (`Class.UIListLayout.FillDirection|FillDirection` set to `Enum.FillDirection.Vertical`), the `Class.UIListLayout.HorizontalFlex|HorizontalFlex` property specifies how to distribute the siblings across the **horizontal cross‑direction**. In such layouts, a setting of `Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill` makes the siblings fill the entire horizontal space while vertical spacing adheres to `Class.UIListLayout.VerticalFlex|VerticalFlex`. ##### AutomaticSize Interaction If `Class.GuiObject.AutomaticSize` is enabled for a child of the `Class.UIListLayout` in the `Class.UIListLayout.FillDirection|FillDirection`, it is interpreted as "automatic flex basis" and it defines the size of the `Class.GuiObject` from which it can grow or shrink. If `Class.GuiObject.AutomaticSize` is enabled for a child of the `Class.UIListLayout` in the **cross‑direction**, it is interpreted as "automatic cross size" and it defines the minimum size needed to contain all the child's content in the cross‑direction.
property/UIListLayout/HorizontalFlex.title: HorizontalFlex

property/UIListLayout/ItemLineAlignment.description:
In a flex layout, defines the **cross-directional** alignment of siblings within a line. In a [flex layout](../../../ui/list-flex-layouts.md#flex-layouts), defines the **cross-directional** alignment of siblings within a line. See `Enum.ItemLineAlignment` for visual examples.
Setting Sibling Behavior
Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Automatic|Automatic Aligns the layout's siblings or the specific Class.UIFlexItem parent to the layout's Class.UIListLayout.HorizontalAlignment|HorizontalAlignment or Class.UIListLayout.VerticalAlignment|VerticalAlignment, depending on its Class.UIListLayout.FillDirection|FillDirection.
Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Start|Start Aligns the layout's siblings or the specific Class.UIFlexItem parent to the line's top in a horizontal fill or the line's left in a vertical fill.
Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Center|Center Aligns the layout's siblings or the specific Class.UIFlexItem parent to the line's center in either a horizontal or vertical fill.
Enum.ItemLineAlignment.End|End Aligns the layout's siblings or the specific Class.UIFlexItem parent to the line's bottom in a horizontal fill or the line's right in a vertical fill.
Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Stretch|Stretch Stretches the layout's siblings or the specific Class.UIFlexItem parent to fill the entire cross‑direction of the line in either a horizontal or vertical fill.
property/UIListLayout/ItemLineAlignment.title: ItemLineAlignment

property/UIListLayout/Padding.description:
Amount of free space between each element.

Determines the amount of free space between each element, set to either a
scale (percentage of the parent's size in the current direction) or an
offset (static spacing value similar to pixel size).
property/UIListLayout/Padding.title: Padding

property/UIListLayout/VerticalFlex.description:
Controls how to distribute extra vertical space. When the list layout's `Class.UIListLayout.FillDirection|FillDirection` is set to `Enum.FillDirection.Vertical`, the `Class.UIListLayout.VerticalFlex|VerticalFlex` property specifies how to distribute extra vertical space in the parent container.
Setting Sibling Behavior
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None|None No flex behavior; siblings maintain their defined height.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill|Fill Siblings resize vertically to fill the entire parent container, overriding their defined height. The number of siblings in a column remain unchanged; for example, if three siblings fit vertically within the container's height under the Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None|None setting, those three siblings will resize to fill the entire height.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceAround|SpaceAround Siblings maintain their defined height. Equal spacing is added on both sides of each sibling.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceBetween|SpaceBetween Siblings maintain their defined height. Equal spacing is added between siblings, but no additional space is added around siblings.
Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceEvenly|SpaceEvenly Siblings maintain their defined height. Equal spacing is added both between and around siblings.
##### Cross-Direction Behavior In **horizontal** list layouts (`Class.UIListLayout.FillDirection|FillDirection` set to `Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal`), the `Class.UIListLayout.VerticalFlex|VerticalFlex` property specifies how to distribute the siblings across the **vertical cross direction**. In such layouts, a setting of `Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill` makes the siblings fill the entire vertical space while horizontal spacing adheres to `Class.UIListLayout.HorizontalFlex|HorizontalFlex`. ##### AutomaticSize Interaction If `Class.GuiObject.AutomaticSize` is enabled for a child of the `Class.UIListLayout` in the `Class.UIListLayout.FillDirection|FillDirection`, it is interpreted as "automatic flex basis" and it defines the size of the `Class.GuiObject` from which it can grow or shrink. If `Class.GuiObject.AutomaticSize` is enabled for a child of the `Class.UIListLayout` in the **cross‑direction**, it is interpreted as "automatic cross size" and it defines the minimum size needed to contain all the child's content in the cross‑direction.
property/UIListLayout/VerticalFlex.title: VerticalFlex

property/UIListLayout/Wraps.description: Controls whether siblings within the parent container wrap. Controls whether siblings within the parent container wrap to another line when their default size exceeds the width/height of the container's bounds.
property/UIListLayout/Wraps.title: Wraps

property/UIPadding/PaddingBottom.description: Padding to apply on the bottom side, relative to the parent's normal size.
property/UIPadding/PaddingBottom.title: PaddingBottom

property/UIPadding/PaddingLeft.description: Padding to apply on the left side, relative to the parent's normal size.
property/UIPadding/PaddingLeft.title: PaddingLeft

property/UIPadding/PaddingRight.description: Padding to apply on the right side, relative to the parent's normal size.
property/UIPadding/PaddingRight.title: PaddingRight

property/UIPadding/PaddingTop.description: Padding to apply on the top side, relative to the parent's normal size.
property/UIPadding/PaddingTop.title: PaddingTop

property/UIPageLayout/Animated.description:
Whether or not to animate transitions between pages.

When set to true, page transitions use the configured
`Class.UIPageLayout.EasingStyle`, `Class.UIPageLayout.EasingDirection`,
and `Class.UIPageLayout.TweenTime` to animate the movement between pages.
When set to false, page transitions are instantaneous. Defaults to `true`.
property/UIPageLayout/Animated.title: Animated

property/UIPageLayout/Circular.description:
Whether or not the page layout wraps around at the ends.

When set to true, navigating past the last page wraps around to the first
page, and navigating before the first page wraps to the last. Animated
transitions take the shortest rotational path around the wrap boundary.
When set to false, navigation stops at the first and last pages. Defaults
to `false`.
property/UIPageLayout/Circular.title: Circular

property/UIPageLayout/CurrentPage.description:
The page that is either currently being displayed or is the target of the
current animation.

A read-only reference to the `Class.GuiObject` sibling that is currently
displayed or is the target of an in-progress animation. The layout updates
this property when pages change via `Class.UIPageLayout:Next()`,
`Class.UIPageLayout:Previous()`, `Class.UIPageLayout:JumpTo()`,
`Class.UIPageLayout:JumpToIndex()`, or through user input (touch swipe,
scroll wheel, or gamepad). If no page has been explicitly navigated to, it
defaults to the first visible `Class.GuiObject` sibling in layout order.
property/UIPageLayout/CurrentPage.title: CurrentPage

property/UIPageLayout/EasingDirection.description:
The easing direction to use when performing an animation.

Determines the direction component of the easing function applied during
animated page transitions. Combined with `Class.UIPageLayout.EasingStyle`
to form the full tween curve. Only takes effect when
`Class.UIPageLayout.Animated` is true. Defaults to
`Enum.EasingDirection.Out`.
property/UIPageLayout/EasingDirection.title: EasingDirection

property/UIPageLayout/EasingStyle.description:
The easing style to use when performing an animation.

Determines the easing curve applied during animated page transitions.
Combined with `Class.UIPageLayout.EasingDirection` to form the full tween
curve. Only takes effect when `Class.UIPageLayout.Animated` is true.
Defaults to `Enum.EasingStyle.Back`.
property/UIPageLayout/EasingStyle.title: EasingStyle

property/UIPageLayout/GamepadInputEnable.description:
Controls the overrides of `NextSelection{Up, Down, Left, Right}`. Defaults
to true.

When set to true, the layout overrides sibling
`Class.GuiObject.NextSelectionLeft` and
`Class.GuiObject.NextSelectionRight` (for horizontal fill direction) or
`Class.GuiObject.NextSelectionUp` and `Class.GuiObject.NextSelectionDown`
(for vertical fill direction) so that gamepad directional navigation moves
between pages. Additionally, the L1 and R1 bumper buttons advance to the
previous and next page respectively. When false, gamepad input does not
interact with the layout. Defaults to `true`.
property/UIPageLayout/GamepadInputEnable.title: GamepadInputEnabled

property/UIPageLayout/Padding.description:
Determines the amount that pages are separated from each other by.

Determines the amount that pages are separated from each other by. Can be
set either using scale (Percentage of parent's size in the current
direction) or offset (a static spacing value, similar to pixel size).
property/UIPageLayout/Padding.title: Padding

property/UIPageLayout/ScrollWheelInputEn.description:
Controls the use of scroll wheel, in case that it is intended for
something else. Defaults to true.

When set to true, mouse scroll wheel input navigates between pages.
Scrolling up moves to the previous page and scrolling down moves to the
next page. Set this to false when the scroll wheel is intended for other
interactions in the UI. Defaults to `true`.
property/UIPageLayout/ScrollWheelInputEn.title: ScrollWheelInputEnabled

property/UIPageLayout/TouchInputEnabled.description:
Controls touch scrolling, in case this is a non-interactive layout.
Defaults to true.

When set to true, touch-based swipe gestures navigate between pages. Set
this to false for layouts where touch input should not trigger page
transitions, such as non-interactive displays. Defaults to `true`.
property/UIPageLayout/TouchInputEnabled.title: TouchInputEnabled

property/UIPageLayout/TweenTime.description:
The length of the animation.

The duration, in seconds, of the animated transition when navigating
between pages. The value is clamped to a minimum of 0.01. Only takes
effect when `Class.UIPageLayout.Animated` is true. Defaults to `1`.
property/UIPageLayout/TweenTime.title: TweenTime

property/UIScale/Scale.description:
Determines the multiplier to apply to the parent UI element's size.

The Scale property determines the multiplier used on the parent UI
element's `Class.GuiBase2d.AbsoluteSize`. When set to 0.5, an AbsoluteSize
of {0, 200}, {0, 50} becomes {0, 100}, {0, 25}. Similarly, when set to 2,
such an AbsoluteSize would become {0, 400}, {0, 100}.
property/UIScale/Scale.title: Scale

property/UIShadow/BlurRadius.description:
Determines the shadow's blurriness.

This property determines the shadow's blurriness. A larger value makes the
shadow's edges appear softer.

Note that the scale factor of this `Datatype.UDim` property is relative to
the parent's width or height, whichever is shorter. This property must
also be non-negative; a negative value will be treated as `0`.
property/UIShadow/BlurRadius.title: BlurRadius

property/UIShadow/Color.description:
Determines the shadow's color.

This property determines the shadow's color.
property/UIShadow/Color.title: Color

property/UIShadow/Enabled.description:
Determines whether the `UIShadow` is visible.

This property determines whether the `UIShadow` is visible. Default is
`true`.
property/UIShadow/Enabled.title: Enabled

property/UIShadow/Offset.description:
Moves the shadow relative to the parent's position.

This property moves the shadow relative to the parent's position. The X
scale factor is relative to the parent's width, and the Y scale factor is
relative to the parent's height.
property/UIShadow/Offset.title: Offset

property/UIShadow/Spread.description:
Expands or shrinks the shadow relative to the parent's size.

This property expands or shrinks the shadow relative to the parent's size.
The X scale factor is relative to the parent's width, and the Y scale
factor is relative to the parent's height. Properties that are relative to
the parent's size, such as the scale factors of
`Class.UIShadow.BlurRadius|BlurRadius` and `Class.UIShadow.Offset|Offset`,
are not affected by `Spread`.
property/UIShadow/Spread.title: Spread

property/UIShadow/Transparency.description:
Sets the shadow's transparency.

This property sets the shadow's transparency, with `0` being fully opaque
and `1` being fully transparent.
property/UIShadow/Transparency.title: Transparency

property/UIShadow/ZIndex.description:
Determines the shadow's render order relative to sibling `UIShadow`
instances.

If a UI instance has multiple shadows, they are rendered in order of
increasing `ZIndex`. Since all shadows are rendered below the parent
instance, `ZIndex` can only be negative.
property/UIShadow/ZIndex.title: ZIndex

property/UISizeConstraint/MaxSize.description:
The largest size, in pixels, the parent object is allowed to be.

The largest size, in pixels, the parent object is allowed to be. The **X**
and **Y** of this value must be greater than or equal to the corresponding
components of `Class.UISizeConstraint.MinSize|MinSize`.
property/UISizeConstraint/MaxSize.title: MaxSize

property/UISizeConstraint/MinSize.description:
The smallest size, in pixels, the object is allowed to be.

The smallest size, in pixels, the object is allowed to be. The **X** and
**Y** of this value must be less than or equal to the corresponding
components of `Class.UISizeConstraint.MaxSize|MaxSize`.
property/UISizeConstraint/MinSize.title: MinSize

property/UIStroke/ApplyStrokeMode.description: Determines whether to apply the stroke to the object's border instead of the text itself. When a `Class.UIStroke` instance is applied to a text object, this property determines whether to apply the stroke to the object's border instead of the text itself.
property/UIStroke/ApplyStrokeMode.title: ApplyStrokeMode

property/UIStroke/BorderOffset.description: Specifies an additional offset to the stroke's position, relative to the parent's minimum height or width. This property specifies an additional offset (`Datatype.UDim`) to the stroke's position, relative to the parent's minimum height or width.
property/UIStroke/BorderOffset.title: BorderOffset

property/UIStroke/BorderStrokePosition.description: Determines the stroke's position on its parent's border. This property determines the stroke's position on its parent's border as an `Enum.BorderStrokePosition` value.
property/UIStroke/BorderStrokePosition.title: BorderStrokePosition

property/UIStroke/Color.description: Determines the stroke color. Determines the `Class.UIStroke` color. You can also insert a `Class.UIGradient` instance as a child to create gradient strokes.
property/UIStroke/Color.title: Color

property/UIStroke/Enabled.description:
Determines whether the stroke in visible.

This property determines whether the `Class.UIStroke` is visible. When set
to `false`, the stroke will not be rendered. Defaults to `true`.
property/UIStroke/Enabled.title: Enabled

property/UIStroke/LineJoinMode.description: Determines how corners are interpreted. This property determines how corners are interpreted. It accepts an `Enum.LineJoinMode` value of either `Enum.LineJoinMode.Round|Round` (default), `Enum.LineJoinMode.Bevel|Bevel`, or `Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter|Miter`.
property/UIStroke/LineJoinMode.title: LineJoinMode

property/UIStroke/StrokeSizingMode.description:
Determines whether the stroke's `Class.UIStroke.Thickness|Thickness` will
be measured in pixels or be relative to the parent.

This property determines whether the stroke's
`Class.UIStroke.Thickness|Thickness` will be measured in pixels or be
scaled relative to the parent. See `Enum.StrokeSizingMode` for further
details.
property/UIStroke/StrokeSizingMode.title: StrokeSizingMode

property/UIStroke/Thickness.description: Determines the stroke's thickness. This property determines the stroke's thickness, measured in pixels (default) or scaled relative to the parent, depending on `Class.UIStroke.StrokeSizingMode|StrokeSizingMode`. Be mindful of [tweening](../../../ui/animation.md) this `Class.UIStroke` property when applied to text objects. This renders and stores many glyph sizes each frame, potentially causing performance issues or text flickering.
property/UIStroke/Thickness.title: Thickness

property/UIStroke/Transparency.description: Sets the stroke opacity independently of the parent object's `Class.GuiObject.BackgroundTransparency|BackgroundTransparency` or `Class.TextLabel.TextTransparency|TextTransparency`. This property sets the stroke opacity independently of the parent object's `Class.GuiObject.BackgroundTransparency|BackgroundTransparency` or `Class.TextLabel.TextTransparency|TextTransparency`. This allows you to render text and borders that are "hollow" (consisting of only an outline).
property/UIStroke/Transparency.title: Transparency

property/UIStroke/ZIndex.description:
Determines the order in which the stroke renders relative to sibling
`Class.UIStroke` instances.

This property determines the order in which the stroke renders relative to
sibling `Class.UIStroke` instances. Those with a lower `ZIndex` render
under (behind) those with a higher `ZIndex`.

Note that the rendering order for `Class.UIStroke` instances with the same
`ZIndex` is undefined. Do not apply multiple `Class.UIStroke` instances
with the same `ZIndex` if their rendering order matters.
property/UIStroke/ZIndex.title: ZIndex

property/UITableLayout/FillEmptySpaceCol.description:
Determines whether cells are sized such that they occupy the horizontal
space of the parent UI element.

FillEmptySpaceColumns determines whether cells' X size are set such that
the entire horizontal space of the parent UI element is used. Enabling
this is useful for making sure your table takes up a more easily
predictable amount of horizontal space (the X-axis size of the parent UI
element). It is still possible that a `Class.UISizeConstraint` applied to
cells will cause underflow/overflow.

When enabling this property, the column widths will be approximately equal
to the parent's `Class.GuiBase2d.AbsoluteSize`.X component divided by the
number of columns (not accounting for padding or other factors).
property/UITableLayout/FillEmptySpaceCol.title: FillEmptySpaceColumns

property/UITableLayout/FillEmptySpaceRow.description:
Determines whether cells are sized such that they occupy the vertical
space of the parent UI element.

FillEmptySpaceRows determines whether cells' Y size are set such that the
entire vertical space of the parent UI element is used. Enabling this is
useful for making sure your table takes up a more easily predictable
amount of vertical space (the Y-axis size of the parent UI element). It is
still possible that a `Class.UISizeConstraint` applied to cells will cause
underflow/overflow.

When enabling this property, the row heights will be approximately equal
to the parent's `Class.GuiBase2d.AbsoluteSize`.Y component divided by the
number of rows (not accounting for padding or other factors).
property/UITableLayout/FillEmptySpaceRow.title: FillEmptySpaceRows

property/UITableLayout/MajorAxis.description:
Determines whether sibling UI elements are treated as rows or columns.

MajorAxis determines whether sibling UI elements are treated as rows or
columns.
property/UITableLayout/MajorAxis.title: MajorAxis

property/UITableLayout/Padding.description:
Determines the empty space between cells.

Padding will position elements with extra space between them. This can be
done using Scale or Offset components of UDim2. Negative values can bring
elements closer together. When non-zero, the sibling UI elements may be
visible between the cells contained within them.
property/UITableLayout/Padding.title: Padding

property/UITextSizeConstraint/MaxTextSiz.description:
The largest size in pixels the font is allowed to be.

This property indicates the largest size in pixels the font is allowed to
be. It defaults to 1000 pixels and must be set larger than or equal to the
`Class.UITextSizeConstraint.MinTextSize|MinTextSize` property.

If the affected `Class.GuiObject` has its
`Class.TextLabel.TextScaled|TextScaled` property set to true the text size
constrained by this property will scale dynamically with the container's
size. It will scale upwards with the GuiObject's size until the max size
is reached, at which point it will stay constant if the UI element
continues to grow.
property/UITextSizeConstraint/MaxTextSiz.title: MaxTextSize

property/UITextSizeConstraint/MinTextSiz.description:
The smallest size in pixels the font is allowed to be.

This property indicated the smallest size in pixels the font is allowed to
be. This value defaults to 1 pixel and must be set less than or equal to
`Class.UITextSizeConstraint.MaxTextSize`.

If the affected `Class.GuiObject` has its
`Class.TextLabel.TextScaled|TextScaled` property set to true the text size
constrained by this property will scale dynamically with the container's
size. It will scale downwards with the GuiObject's size until the min size
is reached, at which point it will stay constant if the UI element
continues to shrink.
property/UITextSizeConstraint/MinTextSiz.title: MinTextSize

property/UniversalConstraint/LimitsEnabl.description:
Determines whether the angular motion of attachments' primary axes is
limited.

This property, when enabled, limits the relative angular motion of the
primary axes of attachments through a cone constraint. The default value
is false.
property/UniversalConstraint/LimitsEnabl.title: LimitsEnabled

property/UniversalConstraint/MaxAngle.description:
The max angle, in degrees, of the constraint's limiting cone.

This property determines the max angle, in degrees, of the constraint's
limiting cone, formed from `Class.Constraint.Attachment0|Attachment0` and
its primary axis. The default value is 45 degrees.

In order for this property to take affect, the constraint's
`Class.UniversalConstraint.LimitsEnabled|LimitsEnabled` property must be
set to true.
property/UniversalConstraint/MaxAngle.title: MaxAngle

property/UniversalConstraint/Radius.description:
The constraint's visualization radius.

This property indicates the constraint's visualization radius, in studs.
Default value is 0.2.
property/UniversalConstraint/Radius.title: Radius

property/UniversalConstraint/Restitution.description:
The restitution coefficient of the cone constraint.

This property determines the restitution of the two
`Class.Attachment|Attachments` connected by the
`Class.UniversalConstraint` when they reach the end of the range specified
by `Class.UniversalConstraint.MaxAngle|MaxAngle`. The value defaults to 0
and can be any floating number in the range of 0 to 1. Only applies when
`Class.UniversalConstraint.LimitsEnabled|LimitsEnabled` is set to true.
property/UniversalConstraint/Restitution.title: Restitution

property/UserGameSettings/BadgeVisible.description: Indicates whether badge notifications are visible to the client.
property/UserGameSettings/BadgeVisible.title: BadgeVisible

property/UserGameSettings/CameraMode.description: The custom camera mode currently in-use by the client.

property/UserGameSettings/ChatVisible.description: Indicates whether the in-game chat is visible to the client.

property/UserGameSettings/ComputerCamera.description: The camera movement mode currently in-use by the client on desktop.

property/UserGameSettings/ControlMode.description: Toggles whether or not the client can use the Mouse Lock Switch mode.

property/UserGameSettings/Fullscreen.description: Indicates whether the client's window is currently in full screen mode.
property/UserGameSettings/Fullscreen.title: Fullscreen

property/UserGameSettings/GamepadCameraS.description: Describes how sensitive the camera is when using a gamepad.
property/UserGameSettings/GamepadCameraS.title: GamepadCameraSensitivity

property/UserGameSettings/GraphicsOptimi.description:
The graphics optimization mode used by the client to balance visual

property/UserGameSettings/GraphicsOptimi.title: GraphicsOptimizationMode

property/UserGameSettings/GraphicsQualit.description: The current graphics quality level being used by the client.
property/UserGameSettings/GraphicsQualit.title: GraphicsQualityLevel

property/UserGameSettings/HasEverUsedVR.description: Indicates whether the user has ever launched the client in VR mode.

property/UserGameSettings/MasterVolume.description: A float between 0 and 1 representing the volume of the game's client. A float between 0 and 1 representing the volume of the game's client.
property/UserGameSettings/MasterVolume.title: MasterVolume

property/UserGameSettings/MasterVolumeSt.description:
A float between 0 and 1 representing the master volume used in Roblox
Studio.

property/UserGameSettings/MouseSensitivi.description:

property/UserGameSettings/OnboardingsCom.description: A comma-separated list of onboarding IDs that the user has completed.

property/UserGameSettings/PartyVoiceVolu.description: A float between 0 and 1 representing the volume of party voice chat.
property/UserGameSettings/PartyVoiceVolu.title: PartyVoiceVolume

property/UserGameSettings/PeoplePageLayo.description: The layout style used to display the people page in the in-game menu.
property/UserGameSettings/PeoplePageLayo.title: PeoplePageLayout

property/UserGameSettings/PlayerListVisi.description: Indicates whether the in-game player list is visible to the client.
property/UserGameSettings/PlayerListVisi.title: PlayerListVisible

property/UserGameSettings/PlayerNamesEna.description: Indicates whether player names are displayed above characters in the game.
property/UserGameSettings/PlayerNamesEna.title: PlayerNamesEnabled

property/UserGameSettings/RCCProfilerRec.description:
Internal MicroProfiler setting specifying the frame rate used when

property/UserGameSettings/RCCProfilerRec.description:
Internal MicroProfiler setting specifying the duration over which

property/UserGameSettings/UsedCustomGuiI.description:

Indicates whether the user has used the keyboard shortcut for hiding the
HUD.

property/UserGameSettings/VREnabled.description: Indicates whether the client is currently running in VR mode.

property/UserGameSettings/VRRotationInte.title: VRRotationIntensity

property/UserGameSettings/VRSmoothRotati.title: VRSmoothRotationEnabled

property/UserGameSettings/VoiceChatVolum.description: A float between `0` and `2` representing the volume of in-game voice chat.

property/UserInputService/AccelerometerE.description:
Describes whether the user's device has an accelerometer.

This property describes whether the user's device has an accelerometer, a
component found in most mobile devices that measures acceleration (change
in speed).

If the device has an enabled accelerometer, you can get its current
acceleration by using the
`Class.UserInputService:GetDeviceAcceleration()|GetDeviceAcceleration()`
method or track when the device's acceleration changes through the
`Class.UserInputService.DeviceAccelerationChanged|DeviceAccelerationChanged`
event.
property/UserInputService/AccelerometerE.title: AccelerometerEnabled

property/UserInputService/GamepadEnabled.description:
Describes whether the user's device has an available gamepad.

This property describes whether the user's device has an available
gamepad. If `true`, you can use gamepad‑related methods such as
`Class.UserInputService:GetConnectedGamepads()|GetConnectedGamepads()`.

For seamless cross-platform compatibility on mixed-input devices, see
`Class.UserInputService.PreferredInput|PreferredInput` which more
accurately reflects which input (mouse/keyboard, touch, gamepad, etc.) the
player is likely using as the **primary** input.
property/UserInputService/GamepadEnabled.title: GamepadEnabled

property/UserInputService/GyroscopeEnabl.description:
Describes whether the user's device has a gyroscope.

This property describes whether the user's device has a gyroscope, a
component found in most mobile devices that detects orientation and
rotational speed.

If the device has a gyroscope, you can incorporate it into your experience
using the `Class.UserInputService:GetDeviceRotation()|GetDeviceRotation()`
method or track when the device's rotation changes through the
`Class.UserInputService.DeviceRotationChanged|DeviceRotationChanged`
event.
property/UserInputService/GyroscopeEnabl.title: GyroscopeEnabled

property/UserInputService/KeyboardEnable.description:
Describes whether the user's device has a keyboard available.

This property describes whether the user's device has a keyboard
available. If `true`, you can use key‑related methods such as
`Class.UserInputService:IsKeyDown()|IsKeyDown()` or
`Class.UserInputService:GetKeysPressed()|GetKeysPressed()`.

For seamless cross-platform compatibility on mixed-input devices, see
`Class.UserInputService.PreferredInput|PreferredInput` which more
accurately reflects which input (mouse/keyboard, touch, gamepad, etc.) the
player is likely using as the **primary** input.
property/UserInputService/KeyboardEnable.title: KeyboardEnabled

property/UserInputService/ModalEnabled.deprecationMessage:
This item has been superseded by `Class.GuiService.TouchControlsEnabled`
which should be used in all new work.
property/UserInputService/ModalEnabled.description:
Toggles whether Roblox's mobile controls are hidden on mobile devices.

The `ModalEnabled` property determines whether character controls are
hidden on `Class.UserInputService.TouchEnabled|TouchEnabled` devices. By
default, this property is `false` and controls are visible.

This property will only work when used in a `Class.LocalScript` running
for the player whose character controls are to be hidden.

Even if mobile controls are hidden for a player on a touch‑enabled device,
other events such as `Class.UserInputService.InputBegan|InputBegan` and
`Class.UserInputService.TouchSwipe|TouchSwipe` can still be used to
process other forms of input.
property/UserInputService/ModalEnabled.title: ModalEnabled
property/UserInputService/ModalEnabled.x-roblox-deprecation-message:
This item has been superseded by `Class.GuiService.TouchControlsEnabled`
which should be used in all new work.

property/UserInputService/MouseBehavior.description:
Determines whether the user's mouse can be moved freely or is locked.

This property sets how the user's mouse behaves based on the
`Enum.MouseBehavior` enum. It can be set to three values:

- `Enum.MouseBehavior.Default` — The mouse moves freely around the
  user's screen.
- `Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter` — The mouse is locked and cannot
  move from the center of the user's screen.
- `Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition` — The mouse is locked and
  cannot move from its current position on the user's screen at the time
  of locking.

The value of this property does not affect the sensitivity of events
tracking mouse movement. For example,
`Class.UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()|GetMouseDelta` returns the same
`Datatype.Vector2` screen position in pixels regardless of whether the
mouse is locked or able to move freely around the user's screen. As a
result, default scripts like those controlling the camera are not impacted
by this property.

This property is overridden if a `Class.GuiButton` with
`Class.GuiButton.Modal|Modal` enabled is `Class.GuiButton.Visible|Visible`
unless the player's right mouse button is down.

Note that if the mouse is locked,
`Class.UserInputService.InputChanged|InputChanged` will still fire when
the player moves the mouse and will pass in the delta that the mouse
attempted to move by. Additionally, if the player is kicked from the
experience, the mouse will be forcefully unlocked.
property/UserInputService/MouseBehavior.title: MouseBehavior

property/UserInputService/MouseDeltaSens.description:
Scales the delta (change) output of the user's `Class.Mouse`.

This property determines the sensitivity of the user's `Class.Mouse`. It
can be used to adjust the sensitivity of events tracking mouse movement,
such as `Class.UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()|GetMouseDelta()`.

This property does not affect the movement of the mouse icon, nor the
camera sensitivity that the user has selected for their client.

This property has a maximum value of `10` and a minimum value of `0`. When
sensitivity is `0`, events that track the mouse's movement will still fire
but all parameters and properties indicating the change in mouse position
will return `0`.
property/UserInputService/MouseDeltaSens.title: MouseDeltaSensitivity

property/UserInputService/MouseEnabled.description:
Describes whether the user's device has a mouse available.

This property describes whether the user's device has a mouse available.
If `true`, you can use mouse‑related methods such as
`Class.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()|GetMouseLocation()`.

For seamless cross-platform compatibility on mixed-input devices, see
`Class.UserInputService.PreferredInput|PreferredInput` which more
accurately reflects which input (mouse/keyboard, touch, gamepad, etc.) the
player is likely using as the **primary** input.
property/UserInputService/MouseEnabled.title: MouseEnabled

property/UserInputService/MouseIcon.description:
The content ID of the image for the user's mouse icon.

This property determines the content ID of the image for the user's mouse
icon. If blank, a default arrow pointer is used. While the cursor hovers
over certain UI objects such as an `Class.ImageButton`,
`Class.TextButton`, `Class.TextBox`, or `Class.ProximityPrompt`, this
image will be overridden and temporarily ignored.

To hide the cursor entirely, do **not** use a transparent image; instead,
set `Class.UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled|MouseIconEnabled` to `false`.
property/UserInputService/MouseIcon.title: MouseIcon

property/UserInputService/MouseIconConte.description:
The content ID of the image for the user's mouse icon. Only supports asset
URIs.

This property determines the content ID of the image for the user's mouse
icon. If blank, a default arrow pointer is used. While the cursor hovers
over certain UI objects such as an `Class.ImageButton`,
`Class.TextButton`, `Class.TextBox`, or `Class.ProximityPrompt`, this
image will be overridden and temporarily ignored. Only asset URIs are
supported for this property.

To hide the cursor entirely, do **not** use a transparent image; instead,
set `Class.UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled|MouseIconEnabled` to `false`.
